item.title: ICC readies to call up Scotland for T20 World Cup 2026 as Bangladesh misses deadline for formal response- Report
item.description: The International Cricket Council (ICC) has reportedly begun the process to call up Scotland for the T20 World Cup 2026, as the Bangladesh Cricket Board (BCB) failed to file a formal response within the stipulated 24-hour deadline, confirming whether they will play in the ICC tournament or not. BCB failed to communicate its position to the ICC within the timeframe specified, despite media reports indicating that internal discussions were held with government officials and player representation.

item.title: WATCH- “10 years of living the dream”- Jasprit Bumrah shares highlights to celebrate 10-year anniversary of his India debut
item.description: Jasprit Bumrah, arguably India’s greatest-ever fast bowler, celebrated the 10th anniversary of his India debut with a heartfelt post on Instagram, in which he shared highlights of his career in blue, right from his debut to current times. Jasprit Bumrah made his India debut in an ODI against Australia on January 23, 2016. item.title: “His record at No.4 is better, but if..”- Mohammad Kaif on which batting position suits Suryakumar Yadav the best
item.description: Former India cricketer Mohammed Kaif believes that, while India T20I captain Suryakumar Yadav has a better record at No. 4, if the opening combination fires and scores well during the powerplay, he should come in at three and give himself more time to settle in and build his innings. Suryakumar batted at no.3 in 10 of 19 T20I innings last year, scoring 156 runs with an average of 22.29 and a 134.48 strike rate. In the next nine innings at No. 4, he managed only 62 runs at a low average of 6.89.
